_comment: Tier-2: verifies febio::heat#0 — an unregistered <Module type=...> value is not diagnosed, it SEGFAULTS. FEBioModuleSection.cpp hands the string to FEModelBuilder::SetActiveModule() with no existence check. Runs four bad module strings ('heat' and 'biphasic-FSI', both of which OASiS templates used and neither of which exists in FEBio 4.12, plus the pure case errors 'Solid' and 'SOLID') and one positive control ('solid'). Verified 2026-08-03 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d: all four exit with SIGSEGV, no ERROR box, no FAILED! line, no .log file; the positive control reads SUCCESS. The positive control is what makes the four crashes attributable to the module string. CAVEAT shared by every febio fixture: with no febio4 binary installed the fixture prints '<key>=skipped_no_binary' and returns 0, which the prefix-matching expect list accepts — on such a machine the febio tier-2 rows are green without verifying anything. The runner has no per-backend skip routing for febio; treat these rows as meaningful only on a host where check_availability() reports AVAILABLE.
